info.title: Tò He Platform API
info.description: Backend for the Tò He hub. Games never call it directly; see docs/contracts.

get.summary: Allowed avatars and age bands, and how many profiles an account may own.

post.summary: Create an account and its first profile.
Sign in; sets the session cookie.

get.summary: The device session (account, profiles, active profile, parent gate); 204 when signed out.

put.summary: Choose who plays on this device. Locks the parent gate.

post.summary: Re-enter the password to manage the account's profiles for a few minutes.

patch.summary: Turn the account's telemetry on or off.

post.summary: Add a profile to the account (at most five).

patch.summary: Edit one of the account's profiles.

delete.summary: Remove one of the account's profiles — never the last one.

get.summary: Games available in the hub, filtered by the active profile's age band.
One game by id (not found if the active profile is too young for it).
Every save of the active profile, for a device to catch up.

put.summary: Store the active profile's save of a game; the last write wins.

post.summary: Record runs of the active profile; the same clientId again raises that run's score.

get.summary: Best score of each of the account's profiles on a game's board.

post.summary: Store a batch of technical telemetry from a device (sent by the hub with sendBeacon).

get.summary: Errors, frame times, metrics and counts per game version over the last days (operator token).
Rooms of a game the active profile may see: public ones it may join, and the ones it sits at.

post.summary: Open a room for a game; the active profile hosts it and takes the first seat.

get.summary: Open rooms the active profile sits at, to go back to one.
The active profile's online results in a game, and its account's board over the last 7 days.
The active profile's last 20 finished online hands of a game, newest first.
A finished hand the active profile played, with its seed and actions, to replay it in the game.
A room by its 6-digit code (spaces ignored), to preview before joining; rate limited.
A room the active profile sits at, or may see in the lobby.

patch.summary: The host changes the room before a hand: seats, visibility, lock, bots, timer, house rules.

post.summary: Sit at a room: an empty seat, or between hands a bot's.
Watch a table without a seat, if its host allows spectators: only what is public is shown.
Ask another of the account's profiles to the table: it shows in their hub for 10 minutes.

get.summary: Tables the account's other profiles asked the active profile to, for the next 10 minutes.

post.summary: Leave the seat; during a hand a bot finishes it. The room closes when the last person leaves.

put.summary: The host seats a bot, or empties a seat (removing a bot or a player).

post.summary: The host starts the first hand; empty seats get bots if the room fills them.
